name: Impact Burst
description: A short stylized hit: bright flash plus rays that shoot outward and fade.

spread.label: Spread
spread.description: 360 = full ring; smaller values fan the rays around +X (use Rotation to aim)

travel_distance.label: Travel distance
travel_distance.description: How far each ray moves outward

start_radius.label: Start radius
start_radius.description: Distance from the centre where rays begin

flash_portion.label: Flash duration
flash_portion.description: Fraction of the effect duration the flash is visible

angle_jitter.label: Angle jitter
angle_jitter.description: Random angle offset per ray (uses seed)

length_variance.label: Length variance
length_variance.description: Random length change per ray (uses seed)

stagger.label: Stagger
stagger.description: Random start offset per ray, as a fraction of duration
